rationale: Qualified strict Standard WB97M-V owners (Direct and fitted) anchor VV10 on the native cold guess, as transported densities already do, instead of first solving the semilocal/RSH-only provisional problem whose DIIS history is discarded when VV10 enters. Physical target energy/MO-gradient convergence, canonical density/force proofs, fresh energy epochs, CDIIS resets and finite proposal budgets are unchanged. Mixed, budget, strict, device-chunk and other unqualified owners keep the seed stage. Unset is the qualified default; explicit 1 restores the seed stage. No new storage, GPU-model/size hardcoding or CPU/reference production dependency.
revisit_condition: Require complete clean cold/warm energy+analytic-force endpoints with work counts on the affected owners before extending the guard to mixed or budget owners. Re-measure water-12 Direct, where the anchored start trades one Fock for one extra SCF pair sweep.
